title: Enable and Explore Actuator Endpoints
description: Add Actuator, expose endpoints, and explore their responses.
problemStatement:
Add Spring Boot Actuator to your existing Spring Boot application. Then:
1. Expose all Actuator endpoints over HTTP.
2. Visit the following endpoints and write down what you see:
   - `/actuator` (the index)
   - `/actuator/health` (check details)
   - `/actuator/info` (add custom info via properties)
   - `/actuator/beans` (count the number of beans)
   - `/actuator/metrics` (find a metric for memory usage)
3. In `application.properties`, add `info.app.name=My Awesome App` and `info.app.version=1.0` and verify they appear in `/info`.
4. Restrict endpoints to only `health`, `info`, and `metrics` after exploring.

**Bonus:** Change the base path to `/manage` and verify.
expectedOutput: You should be able to access endpoints like `http://localhost:8080/actuator/health` (or `/manage/health` if you changed the path). The `/info` endpoint should show the custom info. After restricting, only the specified endpoints should be accessible.
solutionCode:
// pom.xml addition
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
</dependency>

// application.properties
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=*
info.app.name=My Awesome App
info.app.version=1.0

// Later, to restrict:
# management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,metrics
